A.K.M. Shahidul Huq, J: On an application at the instance of the petitioner a Rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the scheduled property published in the Bangladesh gazette vide Notification No. 31.00.0000.040.53.005.2012-271 dated 25.04. 2012 under Upazila Saturia at Serial No. 398 appertaining to S.A. Khatian No. 102 S.A Dag No. 102 and 101. R. S. Khatian No. 75 and R.S Dag Nos. 192 and 93 measuring of total .75 acre of land circulated as 'Ka' Schedule under Mouza Paragram J. L. No. 89 District Manikgonj as contained in Annexure 'F' and as to why the scheduled property published in the Bangladesh Gazette vide Notification No. 31.00.0000.040.53.005. 2012-271 dated 25.04.2012 under Upazila Saturia at serial No. 404 appearing to S. A. Khatian Nos. 2 and 14. S. A. Dag Nos. 1, 2, 4, 7, 5, 3, 13, 10, 16 measuring of total 9.73 acres of land circulated as `KA' Schedule under Mouza Ashlea Paragram J. L. No. 101 District Manikgonj as contained in Annexure-G should not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and for why such other or further order or orders as to this court may seem fit and proper should not be passed. 

 6. The Gazette Schedule property under Annexure F' recorded in the name of Dina Bandhu Chowdhury in the S.A. Khatian No. 102, pertaining to S.A. Dag No- 102and 101. Thereafter, upon transfer of the same as Debuttor Property subsequent R.S Khatian No-75 pertaining to Dag No-192 and 193 recorded in the name of sree Sree Gopal Deb Bigraha and its Sebayet Dinesh Rai Chowdhury son of Dina Bandhu Rai Chowdhury. 

 7. Just like the same, Gazette Scheduled Property under Annexure- G recorded in the name Dina Bandhu Chowdhury son of Fanindra Mohan Chowdhury in the S. A. Khatian No-2/14 pertaining to Dag No- 1, 6, 7, 5, 4, 3, 2 and S. A. Khatian No-14/30 pertaining to Dag No- 16, 13 and 10. Thereafter, upon transfer of the same as Debuttor Property the subsequent, R.S. Khatian No- 11 pertaining to Dag No- 1, 2, 3, 4 and 05 and R. S. Khatian No-10 pertaining to Dag No- 8, 10 and 16 recorded in the name of Sree Sree Gopal Deb Bigraha and its Sebayet Dinesh Rai Chowdhury son of Dina Bandhu Rai Chowdhury. 

 10. The Gazette Scheduled Property under Annexure-F' was unlawfully and mistakenly enlisted as vested property by the concerned officials in the year, 1986 resulted the same has been incorporated and circulated as 'Ka' Schedule in the Bangladesh Gazette vides Notification no. 31.00.0000.040. 53.005.2012-271 dated 25.04.2012, under Upazila-Saturia, as specified at serial No-398, pertaining to S.A. Khatian No-102, S.A Dag No-102 and 101, R. S. Khatian No-75 R.S. Dag No- 192 and 93 measuring of total .75 acre of land, under Mouja Paragram, J.L. No-89, District-Manikgonj. 

 11. The Gazette Scheduled Property under Annexure-G was also unlawfully and mistakenly enlisted as vested property by the concerned officials in the year 1976 and 1992, resulted the same has been incorporated and circulated as 'Ka' Schedule in the Bangladesh Gazette vides Notification no. 31.00.0000.040.53.005.2012-271 dated 25.04.2012, under 1J pazi la- Saturia, as specified at Serial No-404, pertaining to S.A. Khatian No-2 and 14, S. A Dag No- 1, 2, 4, 7, 5, 3, 13.10 and 16 and Khatian No-11, 10 and R.S. Dag No-1, 16, 9,3/4, 1,10, 8,16 measuring of total 9.73 acre of land, under Mouja Ashlee Paragram, J.L. No-101, District- Manikgonj. 

 24. Mr. A. S. M. Nazmul Haque, the learned Deputy Attorney General appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that the case land of S.A. Khatian No. 2 and 14 vide plot No. 1, 2, 4, 7, 5, 3, 13, 10 and 16 was recorded in the name of Dino Bandhu Chowdhury Son of Fanindra Mohon Chowdhury who left the Country for India during Indo-Pak was in the year of 1965 without transferring the property to else where. As a result, the whole property and was enlisted in the census list of vested property. Thereafter, the case was leased out in favour of Paragram Mashgid Committee, Gonokallan Trust and one Abul Bashar. But the R.S. record was wrongly prepared in the name of Sree Sree Gopal Bigrah. The petitioner or the predecessor of the R.S. recorded owner never took any step for mutation or to pay any LD Tax to the govt. After the promulgation of অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ আইন-২০০১ (২০১১ সাল পর্যন্ত সংশোধিত) the case land was enlisted in ka schedule of vested property as per the provision of section 9 of of , অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ আইন-২০০১ (২০১১ সাল পর্যন্ত সংশোধিত)  It is stated here that of অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ ট্রাইবুনাল Was constituted for releasing any vested property from schedule ka by filing case before অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ ট্রাইবুনাল  Therefore, the petitioner had opportunity for filing a claim before অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ ট্রাইবুনাল  for releasing the case land from schedule ka of vested property. But the petitioner filed a petition bearing numbered as 05 of 2013 for claiming the property as Debottor property which is now pending for hearing.
